name: Polari at Club
description: Curated by Cormac, Polari is a club night that doubles as a label and platform for queer expression in all its forms. Built by and for the community, it leans into a driving, dancefloor-focused energy, playing House, Techno and Disco while keeping things playful and inclusive. The lineup features Michelle Manetti with Adonis, Mute-signed artist HAAi, Carlos Valdes and Romain FX of Fauve Records.
